title: Two new dammarane-type triterpenoids and other constituents from Gymnosporia diversifolia with anti-inflammatory and cytotoxic activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43284-43292
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07080E, Paper
Open Access

Hanh Nhu Thi Hoang, Linh Thuy Thi Tran, The-Huan Tran, Nghia Ai Thi Doan, Hung Quoc Vo, Duyen Ngoc Thi Nguyen, Hoai Thi Nguyen, Anh Tuan Le, Hien Minh Nguyen, Duc Viet Ho
Eighteen compounds, including two new triterpenoids, were isolated from G. diversifolia. Compounds 3, 7, and 8 inhibited NO production, while 1–3, 7, 8, 11, 15, and 16 showed cytotoxicity.
